name: siteory
description: Audit websites for SEO, AI visibility and security from Codex: skills that check local builds with the bundled Siteory checker and fix the findings, plus the Siteory MCP server for full audits, reports and rescans.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and fix SEO, AI visibility and security
interface.longDescription: Siteory checks a site or local dev server for SEO, AI visibility (AEO/GEO) and security problems. The skills run the bundled checker against localhost or a deployed URL, fix the findings in your code by framework, and verify each fix. The Siteory MCP server adds full hosted audits, Markdown reports, rescans and before/after comparisons. Sign-in is OAuth in the browser; there is no API key.
defaultPrompt: Check http://localhost:3000 with Siteory and fix the highest-priority findings.
Why can't ChatGPT and Claude read my homepage? Check it with Siteory.
Add the missing security headers to this app and verify them with Siteory.
